components.name: Amber Magnetic WhatsApp CTA
components.description: High-contrast amber CTA button (#f58216) with pitch-black typography and GSAP magnetic tracking.
components.html: Contrataciones · Contactar al DúoWhatsApp Directo · +34 663 03 49 05↗
components.css: .ds-amber-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; width: 100%; max-width: 520px; min-height: 74px; padding: 18px 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f58216; border: 1px solid #ff9838; color: #050505; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(245, 130, 22, 0.22); transition: background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-amber-cta:hover { background: #ff9838; } .ds-cta-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; text-align: left; } .ds-cta-main { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-cta-sub { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.76); } .ds-cta-box { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.22); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ultra-Minimalist Gig Row
components.description: 1px hairline-divided event row with amber hover state on date and city.
components.html: 05Viernes 5 de noviembre de 202718:00 hsSaxoMORAIRA
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 18px 12px; background: #050505; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(246, 244, 240, 0.08); color: #f6f4f0; transition: border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: #0f0e0c; border-bottom-color: rgba(245, 130, 22, 0.45); } .ds-row:hover .ds-num, .ds-row:hover .ds-date, .ds-row:hover .ds-city { color: #f58216; } .ds-num { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-date { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-time { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #d6d2c9; } .ds-venue { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #9a958d; } .ds-city { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #625e57; }

narrative.overview: Inspired by high-contrast nocturnal concert editorials, this system strips away photography and decorative cards so 100% of the visual weight rests on typographic contrast, 1px low-opacity hairlines (rgba(246, 244, 240, 0.08)), and generous negative space over an absolute pitch-black canvas (#050505).
keyCharacteristics: Absolute pitch-black ground (#050505) with ultra-subtle analog film grain (0.032 opacity).
Editorial Serif + Script italic pairing (Playfair Display + Cormorant Garamond) contrasted against geometric sans-serif (Montserrat + Inter) for schedule data.
Ultra-minimalist vertical event ledger divided by 1px hairlines (rgba(246, 244, 240, 0.08)).
Exclusive Luminous Amber (#f58216) reserved strictly for the magnetic WhatsApp button and date row hover states.

rules.name: The Exclusive Amber Rule
rules.body: #f58216 is forbidden on static badges, navigation links, or filter pills. It may only illuminate the primary WhatsApp booking CTA and the interactive hover/touch state of each date row.

dos: Do keep the background at #050505 and rely on 1px low-opacity hairlines (rgba(246, 244, 240, 0.08)) and negative space for structure.
Do restrict #f58216 (amber) exclusively to the WhatsApp CTA button and the hover/touch states of the event rows.
donts: Don't add colored badges, pills, or backgrounds inside the event list rows.
Don't use photographs or heavy card containers; let the serif/sans-serif typographic contrast carry 100% of the visual weight.
